title: Industrial screw driving dataset collection: Time series data for process monitoring and anomaly detection
question: How do surface treatments change the torque–angle evolution and repeatability of screw driving?
publisher: West, Nikolai (Technical University Dortmund); Deuse, Jochen (Technical University Dortmund)
measurement_dates: Acquisition timestamps, where present, are within the native JSON; full campaign dates unknown.
variables_and_units: time, torque, angle, gradient and condition labels
independent_units: complete screw-driving runs and surface conditions
validation_design: complete screw-driving runs and surface conditions Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Native industrial traces and labels, sampled at 833.33 Hz; publisher reports greater than 95% completeness. No curator cleaning.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Use complete operations and component/reuse groups; adjacent repeated screw operations may share material history. Preserve all eight conditions and failed operations.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
